arabic: عَلَيْكَ بِالجِدِّ وإنْ لَمْ يُساعِدِ الجَدُّ.
english: Keep working hard, even when luck is not on your side.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Diligence and Striving, No. 2

arabic: قَدْ سَعِدَ مَنْ جَدَّ.
english: Whoever works hard has found success.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Diligence and Striving, No. 3

arabic: قُرِنَ الإجْتِهادُ بِالوِجْدانِ.
english: Effort and attainment are tied together.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Diligence and Striving, No. 4

arabic: مَنْ ضَعُفَ جِدُّهُ قَوِيَ ضِدُّهُ.
english: When your effort grows weak, whatever stands against you grows strong.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Diligence and Striving, No. 5

arabic: مَنْ رَكِبَ جِدَّهُ قَهَرَ ضِدَّهُ.
english: Ride on your determination and you will overcome what opposes you.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Diligence and Striving, No. 6

arabic: مَنْ أعْمَلَ اجْتِهادَهُ بَلَغَ مُرادَهُ.
english: Put your effort to work and you will reach what you set out for.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Diligence and Striving, No. 7

arabic: مَنْ بَذَلَ جُهْدَ طاقَتِهِ بَلَغَ كُنْهَ إرادَتِهِ.
english: Give all the strength you have, and you will reach the very heart of your goal.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Diligence and Striving, No. 8

arabic: خَيْرُ الإجْتِهادِ ما قارَنَهُ التَّوْفيقُ.
english: The finest effort is the one that Allah's help (tawfiq) walks beside.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Diligence and Striving, No. 1

arabic: لايَنْفَعُ إجتِهادٌ بِغَيرِ تَوْفيق.
english: Effort bears no fruit without Allah's help — so strive, and ask Him for it.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Diligence and Striving, No. 10

arabic: مَنِ اسْتَغْنى عَنِ النّاسِ أغْناهُ اللّهُ سُبْحانَهُ.
english: Whoever stops depending on people, Allah, Glorified be He, makes self-sufficient.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Being Independent of Others, No. 2

arabic: مَنِ اسْتَغْنى كَرُمَ عَلى أهْلِهِ ومَنِ افْتَقَرَ هانَ عَلَيْهِمْ.
english: Stand on your own feet and your family holds you dear; lean on them in need and your standing with them falls.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Being Independent of Others, No. 3

arabic: اِسْتَغْنِ عَمَّنْ شِئْتَ وكُنْ (تَكُنْ) نَظِيرَهُ.
english: Free yourself from needing anyone you choose, and you become that person's equal.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Being Independent of Others, No. 1

arabic: مَنْ تَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللّهِ غَنِيَ عَنْ عِبادِهِ.
english: Whoever relies on Allah no longer needs to depend on His servants.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 26

arabic: حَسْبُكَ مِنْ تَوَكُّلِكَ أنْ لاتَرى لِرِزْقِكَ مُجْرِياً إلاّ اللّهُ سُبْحانَهُ.
english: Your trust is complete when you see no one but Allah as the One who sends your livelihood.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 15

arabic: أصْلُ قُوَّةِ القَلْبِ اَلتَّوَكُّلُ عَلَى اللّهِ.
english: A strong heart has its roots in trusting Allah.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 4

arabic: اَلتَّوَكُّلُ خَيْرُ عِماد.
english: Trust in Allah is the best pillar to lean on.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 8

arabic: تَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللّهِ سُبْحانَهُ فَإنَّهُ قَدْ تَكَفَّلَ بِكِفايَةِ المُتَوَكِّلينَ عَلَيْهِ.
english: Rely on Allah, Glorified be He — He has promised to be enough for all who rely on Him.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 13

arabic: مَنْ تَوَكَّلَ لَمْ يَهْتَمَّ.
english: Whoever truly relies on Allah is freed from worry.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 18

arabic: مَنْ تَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللّهِ كَفاهُ.
english: Whoever relies on Allah — He is enough for him.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 20

arabic: كُنْ مُتَوَكِّلاً تَكُنْ مَكْفِيّاً.
english: Rely on Allah, and your needs will be taken care of.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 23

arabic: مَنْ كانَ مُتَوَكِّلاً لَمْ يَعْدَمِ الإعانَةَ.
english: One who relies on Allah is never left without help.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 25

arabic: مَنْ تَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللّهِ تَسَهَّلَتْ لَهُ الصِّعابُ.
english: For the one who relies on Allah, hard things become easy.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 28

arabic: مَنْ تَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللّهِ ذَلَّتْ لَهُ الصِّعابُ، وتَسَهَّلَتْ لَهُ الأسْبابُ، وتَبَوَّءَ الخَفْضَ والكَرامَةَ.
english: Whoever relies on Allah: obstacles give way, the means open up, and he settles into ease and dignity.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 30

arabic: إيّاكَ أنْ تَتَخَيَّرَ لِنَفْسِكَ، فَإنَّ أكْثَرَ النُّجْحِ فيما لايُحْتَسَبُ.
english: Don't cling to only the path you picked for yourself — most success comes from where you never expected.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 3

arabic: لاتَجْعَلَنَّ لِنَفْسِكَ تَوَكُّلاً إلاّ عَلَى اللّهِ، ولايَكُنْ لَكَ رَجاءٌ إلاّ اللّهُ.
english: Rely on no one but Allah, and pin your hopes on no one but Allah.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 21

arabic: لَيْسَ لِمُتَوَكِّل عَناءٌ.
english: The one who relies on Allah does not carry the burden of distress.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Putting Trust in Allah, No. 24

arabic: أُشْكُرْ تَزِدْ.
english: Give thanks, and you will be given more.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 4

arabic: اِسْتَدِمِ الشُّكْرَ، تَدُمْ عَلَيْكَ النِّعْمَةُ.
english: Keep your gratitude going, and your blessings will keep going too.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 5

arabic: أكْثِرِ النَّظَرَ إلى مَنْ فُضِّلْتَ عَلَيْهِ، فَإنَّ ذلِكَ مِنْ أبْوابِ الشُّكرِ.
english: Look often at those who have been given less than you — it is one of the doors to gratitude.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 7

arabic: اِغْتَنِمُوا الشُّكْرَ، فَأدْنى نَفْعِهِ الزِّيادَةُ.
english: Make the most of gratitude; the very least it brings you is more.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 11

arabic: اَلشُّكْرُ حِصْنُ النِّعَمِ.
english: Gratitude is the fortress that protects your blessings.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 28

arabic: شُكْرُ المُؤْمِنِ يَظْهَرُ في عَمَلِهِ.
english: A believer's thankfulness shows in how he works.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 54

arabic: عَلَيْكَ بِالشُّكْرِ فِي السَّرّاءِ والضَّرّاءِ.
english: Be thankful in good times and in hard times alike.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 65

arabic: لِيَكُنِ الشُّكْرُ شاغِلاً لَكَ عَلى مُعافاتِكَ مِمَّا ابْتُلِيَ بِهِ غَيْرُكَ.
english: Let gratitude keep you busy — for the wellbeing you enjoy, spared from what others are going through.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 73

arabic: مَنْ كَثُرَ شُكْرُهُ تَضاعَفَتْ نِعَمُهُ.
english: The more you give thanks, the more your blessings multiply.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 78

arabic: مَنْ شَكَرَ النِّعَمَ بِجِنانِهِ اِسْتَحَقَّ المَزيدَ قَبْلَ أنْ يَظْهَرَ عَلى لِسانِهِ.
english: Whoever is thankful in the heart has already earned more — even before a word of thanks is spoken.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 92

arabic: ما كانَ اللّهُ سُبْحانَهُ لِيَفْتَحَ عَلى أحَد بابَ الشُّكْرِ ويُغْلِقَ عَلَيْهِ بابَ المَزيد.
english: Allah never opens the door of gratitude for someone and then closes the door of increase.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 101

arabic: لا تَنْسَوْا عِنْدَ النِّعْمَةِ شُكْرَكُمْ.
english: When a blessing arrives, don't forget to give thanks.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 103

arabic: مَنْ بَذَلَ لَكَ جُهْدَ عِنايَتِهِ فَابْذُلْ لَهُ جُهْدَ شُكْرِكَ.
english: When someone gives you their full care, give them your fullest thanks.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 88

arabic: كُنْ فِي السَّرّاءِ عَبْداً شَكُوراً، وَفِي الضَّرّاءِ عَبْداً صَبُوراً.
english: In easy times be a grateful servant; in hard times, a patient one.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 104

arabic: عَلَيْكُمْ بِدَوامِ الشُّكْرِ، ولُزُومِ الصَّبْرِ، فَإنَّهُما يَزيدانِ النِّعْمَةَ، وَيُزيلانِ المِحْنَةَ.
english: Hold on to constant gratitude and steady patience — together they grow your blessings and lift your hardships.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 66

arabic: أبْلَغُ ما تُسْتَمَدُّ بِهِ النِّعْمَةُ الشُّكْرُ، وأعْظَمُ ما تَمَحَّصَ بِهِ المِحْنَةُ الصَّبْرُ.
english: Gratitude is the surest way to keep blessings flowing; patience is the greatest way through a trial.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 17

arabic: مَنْ أُنْعِمَ عَلَيْهِ فَشَكَرَ كَمَنِ ابْتُلِيَ فَصَبَرَ.
english: One who is blessed and gives thanks is like one who is tested and stays patient.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 82

arabic: أحْسَنُ شُكْرِ النِّعَمِ اَلإنْعامُ بِها.
english: The best way to thank Allah for a blessing is to share it with others.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 13

arabic: إذا أنْعَمْتَ بِالنِّعْمَةِ فَقَدْ قَضَيْتَ شُكْرَها.
english: When you use a blessing to benefit someone else, you have paid its thanks.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 36

arabic: شُكْرُ العالِمِ عَلى عِلْمِهِ عَمَلُهُ بِهِ وبَذْلُهُ لِمُسْتَحَقِّهِ.
english: A knowledgeable person thanks Allah for knowledge by living by it and passing it on to those who are ready for it.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 60

arabic: ما شُكِرَتِ النِّعَمُ بِمِثْلِ بَذْلِها.
english: No thanks for a blessing equals giving it freely to others.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 100

arabic: اِجْعَلْ جَزاءَ النِّعْمَةِ عَلَيْكَ الاَحْسانَ إلى مَنْ أساءَ إلَيْكَ.
english: Repay the blessings you have received by doing good even to someone who wronged you.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 9

arabic: أحْسِنُوا جُوارَ نِعَمِ الدّينِ والدُّنيا بِالشُّكْرِ لِمَنْ دَلَّ (دَلَّكُم) عَلَيْها.
english: Honour the blessings of faith and of this world by thanking whoever guided you to them.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 10

arabic: شُكْرُ مَنْ دُونَكَ بِسَيْبِ العَطاءِ.
english: You thank those who have less than you by giving to them generously.
source: Ghurar al-Hikam — Gratitude and the Grateful, No. 49
